note: County and county-equivalent changes between the 2006-2010 ACS (2010 geography) and the 2016-2020 ACS (2020 geography), from Census's 'Substantial Changes to Counties and County Equivalent Entities: 2010-present'. A change map must not difference a county across a boundary change: county population MOEs are 0, so any boundary artifact would read as a significant change. tests/test_county_changes.py fails if a county exists in only one period and is not listed here.
